name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes (BCWD)
kannada_name: ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಇಲಾಖೆಯ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್ ನಂತರದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ
department: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Govt. of Karnataka
target_audience: Post-Matric Students belonging to Category I, 2A, 3A, 3B
description: Financial assistance for post-matriculation studies in recognized institutions across Karnataka to support tuition, maintenance, and educational equipment expenses.
kannada_description: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಮಾನ್ಯತೆ ಪಡೆದ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್ ನಂತರದ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುವ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಧನಸಹಾಯ.
income_limit_display: Rs. 2,50,000 per annum for 2A, 3A, 3B (Rs. 1,50,000 for Category 1)
source_of_information: SSP Karnataka Official Portal Notification 2026-27 / Govt Order BCW 142 BMS 2025

name: Social Welfare Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST
kannada_name: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡದ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್ ನಂತರದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ
department: Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Karnataka
target_audience: Scheduled Caste & Scheduled Tribe students pursuing higher education
description: Comprehensive scholarship covering complete course fees, maintenance allowance, and hostel fee reimbursement for SC/ST students.
kannada_description: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ ಹಾಗೂ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ.
income_limit_display: Rs. 2,50,000 per annum (100% fee concession for eligible categories)
required_documents: Caste Certificate (RD number verified via Nadakacheri)
Aadhaar Card (linked to NPCI bank account)
source_of_information: Govt of Karnataka Social Welfare Secretariat circular SWD 281 KES 2025

name: Vidyasiri – Food and Accommodation Scheme
target_audience: Students who did not secure admission in department post-matric hostels
description: Monthly stipend of Rs. 1,500 per month for 10 months to support food and accommodation expenses for rural students studying away from home.
kannada_description: ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ವಸತಿ ನಿಲಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶಾವಕಾಶ ಸಿಗದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾಸಿಕ 1500 ರೂ. ಊಟ ಮತ್ತು ವಸತಿ ಧನಸಹಾಯ.
required_documents: Rural Study Certificate or Distance Certificate

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
department: Department of Women and Child Development
target_audience: Woman head of household listed on Karnataka Antyodaya/BPL/APL cards
description: Direct benefit transfer of Rs. 2,000 per month to the woman head of household in Karnataka to enhance economic empowerment and domestic stability.
kannada_description: ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಯಜಮಾನಿ ಮಹಿಳೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ರೂ. 2,000 ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು.
required_documents: Ration Card (APL/BPL/AAY showing woman as head)
source_of_information: Govt Order No. WCD 128 SSS 2023, Dated 05-06-2023

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme
department: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood
target_audience: Unemployed graduates and diploma holders from Karnataka
description: Monthly financial assistance (Rs. 3,000 for degree holders and Rs. 1,500 for diploma holders) for up to 2 years to job-seeking youth who graduated recently.
kannada_description: ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗಿ ಪದವೀಧರರಿಗೆ ಮಾಸಿಕ 3,000 ರೂ. ಮತ್ತು ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ ಪೂರೈಸಿದವರಿಗೆ 1,500 ರೂ. ಧನಸಹಾಯ.
income_limit_display: Domiciled in Karnataka, unemployed after 180 days of graduation
required_documents: Degree or Diploma Completion Certificate / Convocation
Karnataka Domicile / Study Certificate (minimum 6 years in Karnataka)
Bank Account seeded with Aadhaar (NPCI mapped)
source_of_information: Govt Order No. SDEL 26 YNS 2023, Dated 26-12-2023
